changes.description: User-mode networking daemons for virtual machines and namespaces
changes.note:
- fix a possible forwarding loop with multicast traffic, https://bugs.passt.top/show_bug.cgi?id=209
- fix forwarding to IPv4 loopback addresses different from 127.0.0.1, https://bugs.passt.top/show_bug.cgi?id=212
- fix operation with initramfs or tmpfs as root filesystem by means of a new --chroot-fallback option, https://bugs.passt.top/show_bug.cgi?id=104
- add optional remapping of inbound destination addresses, available via command line as well as pesto(1)
